responsibilities: Design and build scalable marketing data models, covering multi-touch attribution, digital and offline touchpoints, account-based marketing, funnel analytics and marketing impact.
Develop and manage DBT projects, from staging and intermediate models through to trusted, business-ready data marts.
Build and optimize data pipelines and models with a focus on performance, scalability and cost efficiency.
Partner with Marketing and Operations teams to translate business questions into meaningful metrics, KPIs and reporting solutions.
Help create a consistent and reliable view of marketing performance across complex B2B customer journeys.
Maintain strong standards around data quality, testing, documentation, lineage and governance.
Collaborate with IT and Martech teams to ensure our analytics ecosystem follows security, compliance and engineering best practices.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Maintain strong standards around data quality, testing, documentation, lineage and governance.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality, testing, lineage, governance, security and compliance all appear as responsibilities and no speed or shipping language appears anywhere.
evidence.domain_risk: Experience designing and optimizing Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) models and connecting marketing investment with revenue, ROI and ROAS.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role owns revenue attribution and is explicitly asked to keep the analytics ecosystem within 'security, compliance and engineering best practices', both named high-risk override signals.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Develop and manage DBT projects, from staging and intermediate models through to trusted, business-ready data marts.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: dbt projects and an 'analytics ecosystem' already exist and are named in the responsibilities, but no specialised data sub-teams or scale markers are given.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design and build scalable marketing data models, covering multi-touch attribution, digital and offline touchpoints, account-based marketing, funnel analytics and marketing impact.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name specific modelling problems — multi-touch attribution, account-based marketing, staging-to-marts dbt layers — rather than generic stakeholder boilerplate.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Marketing and Operations teams to translate business questions into meaningful metrics, KPIs and reporting solutions.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Marketing is the named primary audience throughout, with the output framed as campaign performance, attribution and ROI.
evidence.autonomy_level: Help create a consistent and reliable view of marketing performance across complex B2B customer journeys.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are delivery verbs — build, develop, partner, help, collaborate, maintain — with no direction-setting, roadmap or priority-defining language.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Neither AI tooling for the candidate's own work nor AI systems consuming the candidate's output is mentioned anywhere in the posting.
evidence.testing_framing: Maintain strong standards around data quality, testing, documentation, lineage and governance.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing sits in the responsibilities with an ownership verb ('Maintain strong standards'), not only in the skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: We’re looking for a Marketing Analytics Engineer who enjoys turning complex data into something people can actually trust and use.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust is the opening framing of the role and recurs as 'trusted, business-ready data marts', 'reliable data foundation' and a compliance clause, so the dominant fear is untrustworthy marketing numbers reaching decision-makers.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: you’ll help create a reliable data foundation for smarter marketing decisions
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Design, build and create dominate the infrastructure tasks, with no language about repairing or migrating an existing broken setup.
evidence.work_arrangement: Flexible Work: Embrace a hybrid work model blending office and remote setup for a balanced lifestyle.
evidence.loss_aversion: turning complex data into something people can actually trust and use — trust in marketing numbers is the stated reason for the role, reinforced by 'Maintain strong standards around data quality, testing, documentation, lineage and governance.'
ats_keywords: data quality, testing, documentation, lineage and governance
